Existing current-main work outside the exact O01L file set was preserved and left untouched. smallSizeEvidence.gapFormula: abs(upperEndpointY - lowerEndpointY) - (upperStrokeWidth + lowerStrokeWidth) / 2, then multiply by logicalSizePx / 256
smallSizeEvidence.limitation: Reproducible vector-endpoint and stroke-cap measurement; no raster export, device rendering, or runtime use is claimed.
